learning_objectives: Measure an angle using a protractor.
Identify and use vertically opposite angles.
Apply the rule that angles on a straight line add to $180^\circ$.
Apply the rule that angles at a point add to $360^\circ$.
Calculate unknown angles by subtraction from $90^\circ$, $180^\circ$ or $360^\circ$.

concepts.sample_question: A right angle is split into $52^\circ$ and angle $p$. How many degrees is angle $p$?
Angle $q$ and $25^\circ$ lie on a straight line. How many degrees is angle $q$?
Three angles meet at a point: $69^\circ$, $55^\circ$ and angle $r$. How many degrees is angle $r$?
Two straight lines cross. One of the angles is $147^\circ$. How many degrees is the angle next to it on the straight line?
